# AudioBash

> Voice-controlled terminal for developers. Speak commands, execute instantly.

URL: https://jamditis.github.io/audiobash/
Author: Joe Amditis
License: MIT
Repository: https://github.com/jamditis/audiobash

AudioBash is a desktop application that lets developers control their terminal
with voice commands. Built with Electron, React, and xterm.js, it supports
multiple AI providers for voice transcription including Google Gemini, OpenAI
Whisper, and local models.

Key features:
- Voice-to-terminal command execution via push-to-talk hotkey
- Multi-tab split-view terminal with up to 4 panes
- Agent mode with context-aware command generation
- Mobile remote control via WebSocket
- Available for Windows and macOS (Apple Silicon and Intel)
- Multiple AI transcription providers
- Fully customizable hotkeys and settings
